99 baar haar, 100vi baar jeet – yehi lagan hai.
Grit luck nahi; kaam hai.
Jo hansne se dar ko jeet le, wahi sahaswala hai.
Himmat darr ka samna karne ki shakti hai.
Khud pe quit na karna—grit.
Courage confidence ke saath act karne ki ability hai.
Kabhi kabhi khamoshi sabse loud hoti hai.
Calm mind inner strength aur self-confidence laati hai.
Courage matlab disapproval risk karna.
Grit rukavaton ko paar karti hai.
Grit momentum create karta.
Lakshya ke liye stamina grit hai.
Jo believe karte ho, uske liye khade raho—chahe akelay.
Kuch battles ladni padti hain, jinka explain nahi hota.
Chup rehna woh canvas hai jahan buddhi rang bhar deti hai.
Dusron ki opinions humein define na karein—yeh decide karein.
Grit junoon hai.
Main fail nahi—bas 10,000 tareeke mile jo nahi kaam kare.
Lambe raaste se mat daro.
Khamoshi sach hai.
